chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from al-Husayn, from Uthman, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Ubaydullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Verily, keeping ties with close relatives purifies deeds, makes the accounting easy, wards off afflictions, and increases one’s lifespan.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of maintaining family ties in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In the tradition of al-Ahwazi’s *Kitab al-Zuhd*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores *silat al-ram* as a pivotal mechanism for spiritual purification and divine protection. It connects the ethical duty of kinship to tangible metaphysical outcomes, suggesting that maintaining family bonds not only streamlines the accounting of deeds but also serves as a shield against calamities and a means to prolong life.
